title: 第55章 都要给李青山介绍媳妇

第55章 都要给李青山介绍媳妇-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

上一章

存书签

下一章

漆黑的夜晚！

大壮带着一群石溪村的壮劳力，正匆匆在山林中赶着路，按照这个速度的话，明日清晨就能赶到趟子房的位置。

晚上的老林子赶路不容易。

这些村子里的叔伯也都是看在同村人，又是一个姓的才会来，大家都是沾亲带故的，平日里都能互相伸手帮一下，等到了日后，村子里的人，可就不会这么团结了。

次日。

李青山凌晨四点钟就醒了，夏天老林子天亮的早，李青山先是去小溪边洗了个澡，没了继续狩猎的打算，毕竟这次打到的那两只大野猪，已经超出了李青山这次狩猎的预期。

要是打的太多，到时候也不好带回去。

毕竟，也不知道大壮这次带了多少人上山，要是人少的话，就有些麻烦了。

李青山摸了摸胸口的玉葫芦。

想了想后，便将趟子房那只獐子牵了出来，这只獐子腿上的伤势还没恢复，不敢用那一只脚沾地，李青山想着要不用这只獐子试验一下玉葫芦内那滴绿色液体的作用。

掰开獐子的嘴巴，便将绿色液体滴进了獐子的嘴巴里！

结果。

这獐子只是舔了舔舌头，李青山认真观察了半个小时，这獐子没有任何变化。

嗯，至少，这玩意是没毒的。

但具体是什么作用，暂且看不出来。

不管了。

先搞点吃的。

李青山趁着篝火的余温，将木炭全部铲到灶台的下面，铁锅中放水，扔了四只野鸡进去，接下来等到水开后将野鸡煮熟就行了。

当然了，姜片，盐李青山也相继放了进去。

至于白胡椒粉，要留在最后撒。

然后开始打养生拳。

晨曦之下，李青山原本单薄瘦弱的身体，已经有了些肌肉，再养上两三个月，这具身体应该可以恢复成薄肌的那种程度，毕竟蛋白质跟上补充了，锻炼也都相继跟上了。

纯阳真气在体内游走，李青山的招式行云流水。

一拳挥出，衣袖猎猎！

等到什么时候，一拳挥出，周围能发出一阵音爆声，甚至能够看到拳头周围泛起的涟漪，就到了传说中的外劲层次。

“山哥，山哥……！”

Chapter 55: I have to introduce a wife to Li Qingshan - "Go to the Mountain 1957: Two pounds of pork in exchange for a wife"

Dark night!

Da Zhuang and a group of strong laborers from Shixi Village were hurrying through the mountains and forests. According to this speed, they would be able to reach the location of the house tomorrow morning.

It’s not easy to drive through the old forest at night.

The uncles in these villages only come here because they are from the same village and have the same surname. Everyone is related and can help each other on weekdays. But in the future, the people in the village will not be so united.

The next day.

Li Qingshan woke up at four o'clock in the morning. It dawned early in the old forest in summer. Li Qingshan first went to the stream to take a bath. He had no intention of continuing to hunt. After all, the two large wild boars he shot this time had exceeded Li Qingshan's expectations for this hunting.

If you hit too many, it won’t be easy to take them back when the time comes.

After all, I don’t know how many people Da Zhuang brought up the mountain this time. If there were few people, it would be a bit troublesome.

Li Qingshan touched the jade gourd on his chest.

After thinking about it, he took out the deer from the house. The injury on the leg of the deer had not recovered yet and he did not dare to touch the ground with that foot. Li Qingshan thought about using the deer to test the effect of the drop of green liquid in the jade gourd.

Opening the deer's mouth, the green liquid dripped into the deer's mouth!

result.

The deer just licked its tongue. Li Qingshan carefully observed it for half an hour, but there was no change in the deer.

Well, at least, this stuff isn't poisonous.

But what the specific function is, I can’t tell yet.

No matter.

Get some food first.

Li Qingshan took advantage of the remaining warmth of the campfire to shovel all the charcoal under the stove, put water in the iron pot, threw four pheasants in, and then waited until the water boiled to cook the pheasants.

Of course, ginger slices, salt and Li Qingshan were also put in one after another.

As for the white pepper, leave it to be sprinkled at the end.

Then start doing health-preserving boxing.

Under the morning light, Li Qingshan's originally thin and thin body has already gained some muscle. After another two or three months of training, this body should be able to return to the level of thin muscle. After all, protein has been replenished and exercise has kept up.

Pure yang true energy circulates in the body, and Li Qingshan's moves are flowing smoothly.

Punch out, sleeves hunt!

When a punch is thrown out, a sonic boom sound can be heard all around, and ripples can even be seen around the fist. This will reach the legendary level of external force.

"Brother Shan, Brother Shan...!"
